conn.title: Connection Center
conn.simpleTitle: Verify a connection, then keep using Nachuan Auto
conn.simpleHint: Common providers usually need only an API key and Connect. Nachuan automatically selects and verifies one recommended chat model. A few providers also require a model ID or official sign-in; technical fields stay under Advanced.

quick.title: Choose one connection method
quick.hint: Pick an account or local model you already have. Start chatting as soon as verification succeeds.
quick.readyHint: {{n}} verified model source is ready. You can start the first chat.

conn.verificationNotLive: This is a configuration receipt, not a live upstream-health claim
conn.unavailableHint: This connection method has not met the stability and security bar yet.
conn.recommendedModel: One recommended chat model will be verified by default: {{model}}. More candidates are under Advanced.
conn.savedModelCount: Keeping {{n}} model selections saved by this connection. Adjust them under Advanced.
conn.disconnectRejected: Removal was not confirmed; the credential is still stored. Try again.
conn.disconnectFail: The removal result could not be confirmed. Refresh or reopen Connections to verify.
conn.connectPartial: {{n}} models connected; {{m}} others failed verification or are not supported yet.
conn.connectFail: Connection was not applied. Check the credential, model ID, or network; the previous connection was preserved.

failure.invalidCredentials: The API key is invalid, expired, or lacks permission. Copy the correct key again.
failure.quotaOrRateLimited: The account is out of quota or rate-limited. Check the plan balance and try again.
failure.modelOrEndpointNotFound: The model or endpoint was not found. Check the model ID and Base URL.
failure.networkOrTimeout: The model service could not be reached or timed out. Check the network, proxy, or local service.
failure.upstreamUnavailable: The model service is temporarily unavailable. The previous connection was not replaced; try later.
failure.invalidRequest: The model service rejected this configuration. Check the model ID, endpoint, and account permission.
failure.connectorUnavailable: The connector is temporarily unavailable. Try later instead of submitting repeatedly.

conn.connectRefreshUnknown: Verification returned success, but the interface could not refresh the final state. Refresh Connections to verify before submitting again.
conn.loginHint: Connect using the official CLI sign-in state.
conn.keyPhSaved: Verified and stored securely; leave blank to keep it

conn.orphanProvider: Provider id no longer in the catalog
